q: What are your weaknesses and how do you address them?
a:
I have trouble doing many tasks at the same time. When I have many tasks to do, I feel stressed and anxious, and it becomes hard for me to concentrate on all of them at once. Because of this, I prefer to work on one task at a time.

I know that being able to multitask is important, especially for today’s professionals. So, I am trying to improve this skill by starting with simple tasks at the same time. This helps me get used to handling multiple responsibilities simultaneously.

By practicing this way, I hope to improve my multitasking skills.
